scope: PostgreSQL custom enum array_agg with a same-named shadow type
contract: A qualified table column keeps its target-schema enum[] type when a same-named enum in another schema leads search_path.
The aggregate preserves declared enum ordering, the literal NULL label, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL.
The native enum-array type OID, JSON values and wire bytes match after schema-qualified text-carrier rebinding.
A shadow-only enum label is rejected when rebound to the qualified target enum array.

strict_value_matrix.result: 340 tests passed across 11 suites; no missing suites; GTK and DuckDB enabled; PostgreSQL selected 132 tests
